svg.title: Tailwhip stage 1 wiring
svg.text: Tailwhip stage 1: every wire, end to end, on the robot (not to scale)
The mast unfolded about its robot-right (-y) edge: BACK on the left, seen from behind; FRONT on the right, seen from the front. A wire crossing the gap passes from one face to the other.
Positions from stage1/stage1.py. Line colour = wire colour to use. Pins named as printed on each board; bold = used, grey = not connected. A hop means two wires cross without touching.
BACK of the mast and the core, seen from behind
FRONT of the mast and the core, seen from the front
BT1 2 x 18650 holder, on the battery tray on top, under the strap
red + and black - leads leave through the tray's robot-right notch; the strap joining the cells is at the other end
in the back of the core
seen from the pin side; the module faces the mast
labels are printed on the far side: count pins from the USB end
C3 100n across the tabs (pocket above the can)
pad positions vary: go by the printed names
never connect anything else to B-
U6 GY-521, 2 mm off the core front on two M2.5 screws, chip facing forward,
X arrow on the silkscreen pointing up (the mount also takes it 16 wide x 21 tall)
Every wire. Swatch = wire colour. Thick = 22 AWG power and motor wire; thin = 26 AWG or a Dupont jumper. Full detail (gauge, length, connector): electronics.md, Wire list.
W3 holder cell middle (series strap) -> BMS BM
W9 jack centre (+, red) -> BMS P+
W10 jack sleeve (-, black) -> BMS P-
W15 Mini360 OUT+ -> ESP32 5V (row A, pin 1 from USB)
W16 Mini360 OUT- -> ESP32 GND (row A, pin 6 from USB)
W17 JB VS -> ESP32 SVP (row A, pin 17 from USB)
W18 ESP32 IO25 (row A, pin 11 from USB) -> MX1508 IN1
W19 ESP32 IO26 (row A, pin 10 from USB) -> MX1508 IN2
W24 ESP32 3V3 (row A, pin 19 from USB) -> GY-521 VCC
W25 ESP32 GND (row B, pin 19 from USB) -> GY-521 GND
W26 ESP32 IO22 (row B, pin 17 from USB) -> GY-521 SCL
W27 ESP32 IO21 (row B, pin 14 from USB) -> GY-521 SDA
Joins with no wire: C1 legs on the MX1508 + and - pads (stripe to -); R3 from IN1 to - and R4 from IN2 to - under the MX1508; C3 legs on the motor tabs; R1, R2, C2 and the K2 header on JB.
